notes.title: Mariposa DEMO and KICKSTARTER Now Live!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=dgV4FrQYLg0;full][/previewyoutube]
Finally, after over a year of work, our free demo is ready to play! The full experience should take about 1-2 hours to play through, and includes side quests, dialogue, collecting, and outfits to unlock! We hope you enjoy playing it even more than we enjoyed making it!

Keep in mind that this demo is in an alpha state, and is incomplete. It is intended to get across the vision of how the full game and experience will be like once the game is funded through Kickstarter and then developed. Expect a few visual glitches and animation quirks! That being said, we still value any criticism you have! We want to make this the best game we can. You can give us feedback on our social media channels, website, Steam community page, or our support email.
